title: Rational Hodge classes on CM abelian varieties
exact_target: On every complex abelian variety of CM type, is each rational class in $H^{2p}$ of Hodge type (p,p) the class of a rational algebraic codimension-p cycle? All p and all finite products and powers of CM abelian varieties are included.
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
On every complex abelian variety of CM type, is each rational class in $H^{2p}$ of Hodge type (p,p) the class of a rational algebraic codimension-p cycle? All p and all finite products and powers of CM abelian varieties are included.

\subsection{Short English statement}
On every complex abelian variety of CM type, is each rational class in $H^{2p}$ of Hodge type (p,p) the class of a rational algebraic codimension-p cycle? All p and all finite products and powers of CM abelian varieties are included.
